# Flaticon UIcons

Source: https://www.flaticon.com/uicons

Official package: @flaticon/flaticon-uicons, version 3.3.1.
Style: Rounded Regular (outline).

The unmodified WOFF2 is distributed locally so lesson icons also work offline.
The selected glyph codes are declared in ../../flaticon-outline.css.
Lesson/slide assignments and legacy-icon aliases are in ../../../скрипты/lesson-icons.js.

The Flaticon license is included in LICENSE. A visible attribution link is added
to the class/lesson chooser on each lesson page.
